description: This file defines the AWS Config Service client class for the AWS SDK for PHP. It specifies the methods available to interact with AWS Config, both synchronous and asynchronous, and extends the base AwsClient class.

classes.name: ConfigServiceClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Config, providing numerous methods to manage and retrieve configuration information from AWS.

methods.name: associateResourceTypes
methods.description: Associates resource types with AWS Config

methods.name: batchGetAggregateResourceConfig
methods.description: Retrieves configurations of resources in bulk for an aggregated account

methods.name: deleteConfigRule
methods.description: Deletes a specified AWS Config rule

methods.name: describeConfigRules
methods.description: Returns details about your AWS Config rules

methods.name: putConfigRule
methods.description: Adds or updates a Config rule
